title: •Greedo
caption: •Greedo (V)
game_text: During battle, may cancel the game text of a smuggler present with Greedo for remainder of turn. During your control phase, may ▲ one Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?
lore: Male Rodian bounty hunter. Sent by Jabba to capture Han. Arrogant, overconfident and not too bright. Trained by bounty hunters Nataz and Goa, who betrayed him to Thuku.
